title: Geometry optimization
action: Perform a plane‑wave pseudopotential DFT geometry optimization of cubic spinel SiGe₂N₄ using GGA and ultrasoft pseudopotentials to find the equilibrium lattice constant a₀ and the internal anion parameter u.
description: Process step that produces the equilibrium geometry required for all subsequent calculations. The log provides evidence that the optimization ran.

title: Energy‑volume data generation
action: Carry out a series of fixed‑pressure (or fixed‑volume) structural relaxations at several hydrostatic pressures (e.g., 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 GPa) to obtain a set of (volume, total energy) data points. Use the same DFT settings as in the geometry optimization.
description: Process step that generates the E–V data needed for the equation‑of‑state fit and the quasi‑harmonic Debye model.

title: Assemble structural properties
action: From the geometry optimization, extract a₀ and u. Fit the E–V data to the third‑order Birch–Murnaghan equation of state to obtain the zero‑pressure bulk modulus B₀ and its pressure derivative B′. Write the results to `/app/outputs/structural_properties.json`.
description: Ground‑state structural parameters and equation‑of‑state fit results. This step is load‑bearing because it depends on the successful completion of the preceding process steps.

title: Compute elastic constants
action: Using the equilibrium geometry, apply finite strain patterns, compute the resulting stresses, and extract the three independent elastic stiffness coefficients C₁₁, C₁₂, C₄₄. Write to `/app/outputs/elastic_constants.json`.

title: Compute direct band gap
action: Calculate the electronic band structure along high‑symmetry paths. Identify the direct band gap at the Γ point (Γ→Γ transition) and write the value to `/app/outputs/electronic_properties.json`.
description: Direct band gap at the Γ point.

title: Compute static optical constants
action: From the equilibrium wavefunctions, compute the momentum matrix elements, evaluate the dielectric function on a dense k‑mesh, perform Kramers‑Kronig transformation if needed, and extract the static dielectric constant ε(0) and refractive index n(0). Write to `/app/outputs/optical_properties.json`.
description: Static dielectric constant and refractive index.

title: Thermal properties at 300 K
action: Using the E–V data and the quasi‑harmonic Debye model (e.g., Gibbs program), compute the bulk modulus, heat capacity at constant volume Cᵥ, and Debye temperature at T = 300 K and zero pressure. Write to `/app/outputs/thermal_properties_300K.json`.
